blocks.orig: Soar above the breathtaking landscapes of Ruaha National Park with our exclusive hot air balloon flight. Available only from mid June to end of October, this extraordinary experience offers panoramic views of the untouched wilderness, teeming with diverse wildlife. Admire the gentle sunrise painting the sky as you float gracefully above the enchanting savannah. Immerse yourself in the tranquility of the African bush from a unique perspective.
blocks.html: Float high above the stunning scenery of Ruaha National Park on our exclusive hot air balloon flight. This remarkable experience runs only from mid June to end of October and gives you panoramic views over untouched wilderness full of varied wildlife. Watch the soft sunrise colour the sky as you drift smoothly over the captivating savannah. Take in the calm of the African bush from a completely different angle.

blocks.orig: Weight limit: typically 120 kg per person; extra seat may be required if exceeded
blocks.html: Weight limit: usually 120 kg per person; above that, an extra seat may be needed
